race.title: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Lots with chances. MOON CHIME was in the process of running really well (still in front) when falling at the last in the Silver Trophy at Chepstow on his return and this winning stayer on the Flat is worth siding with on his first try over this 3m trip. Recent Ffos Las scorer Kilwaughter heads the list of dangers, although a good case can also be made for the likes of Bill Baxter , Splendid Fellow and Western Monkey in this fascinating handicap. The Jukebox Kid completes the shortlist. MOON CHIME KILWAUGHTER (IRE) BILL BAXTER (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Kilwaughter (11/2), Splendid Fellow (6/1), Western Monkey (13/2), The Jukebox Kid (7/1), Miami Magic (15/2), Doughmore Bay (8/1), Moon Chime (10/1), Masaccio (12/1), Game Colours (14/1), Docpickedme (14/1), One Big Bang (14/1), Gowel Road (25/1), Bill Baxter (25/1), Firestream (25/1), King Of The Lake (25/1), Amirite (33/1), Walking On Air (50/1)
